name: Personal leave, unpaid (事假)
authority: Interim Wage Payment Regulation (劳部发〔1994〕489号) arts.11–12 list the paid absences; personal leave outside them is unpaid, deducted at the monthly wage ÷ 21.75 a day (人社部发〔2025〕2号).

name: Annual leave (带薪年休假)
authority: 职工带薪年休假条例 (State Council Order 514, from 1 January 2008, https://xzfg.moj.gov.cn/front/law/detail?LawID=208) art.2: a worker in continuous work for more than twelve months is entitled; art.3: cumulative service 1–10 years 5 days, 10–20 years 10, 20 or more 15 (statutory holidays and rest days inside it not counted); art.5: unused days paid at 300% of the day wage. 企业职工带薪年休假实施办法 (MOHRSS Order 1, from 18 September 2008, https://rsj.sh.gov.cn/trlzyhshbzbgz_17256/20200617/t0035_1388390.html) art.3: the twelve months may be with this or earlier employers; art.4: service with every employer counts toward the ladder (`employment.prior_service_months`); art.5: a new hire’s year is the calendar days left with this employer ÷ 365 × the full days, the part day dropped; art.12: a leaver’s year is (calendar days with this employer this year ÷ 365) × the full days less days taken, the part day dropped, no clawback of excess. Not modelled: the art.4 disqualifications (long paid personal or sick leave) and deemed service. Recorded defaults where the law is silent (owner rule 2026-09-28; 人社厅函〔2009〕149号, http://www.mohrss.gov.cn/ldgxs/LDGXlaodongbiaozhun/LDGXLgongshixiujia/200904/t20090415_86611.html, answers only the twelve months and cumulative service): the calendar year in which twelve months are first completed is granted in full from the day they are, not pro-rated from that day (a 1 October 2025 hire with no earlier service holds 5 days for 2026 from 1 October 2026, and a 31 December 2026 exit is paid 5); a year in which cumulative service reaches 10 or 20 years is granted the higher band in full from that day (a 1 July 2016 hire holds 5 days for 2026 before 1 July 2026 and 10 from it). Neither grants less than a pro-rated reading.

name: Maternity leave (产假及生育假)
authority: Shanghai: 女职工劳动保护特别规定 (State Council Order 619, from 28 April 2012, https://xzfg.moj.gov.cn/mobile/law/detail?LawID=343) art.7: 98 days of maternity leave, up to 15 before the birth; 15 more for a difficult birth and 15 more for each additional infant; a miscarriage under four months of pregnancy 15 days, at four months or more 42 days. 上海市计划生育奖励与补助若干规定 (沪府规〔2022〕18号, from 1 November 2022 to 31 October 2027, https://www.shanghai.gov.cn/nw12344/20221110/87151565cd6246c99854c129797d178c.html) art.2: a lawful birth adds 60 days of 生育假, taken with the maternity leave and paid as it; the added days extend past a statutory holiday. Each infant beyond the second adds another 15 days, counted as the recorded children born on the event date (`children.multiple_born_on(event.date)`); a multiple birth with fewer than two recorded is refused. The maternity allowance offset against the wage (沪医保规〔2026〕5号) is outside this row. Kunming: 女职工劳动保护特别规定 (State Council Order 619, from 28 April 2012, https://xzfg.moj.gov.cn/mobile/law/detail?LawID=343) art.7: 98 days of maternity leave, up to 15 before the birth; 15 more for a difficult birth and 15 more for each additional infant; a miscarriage under four months of pregnancy 15 days, at four months or more 42 days. 云南省人口与计划生育条例 (third amendment 17 January 2022, https://www.ynrd.gov.cn/html/2022/changweihuigonggao_0118/16355.html) art.18, with art.35 (every leave in the regulation is calendar days; working days inside it are paid): a lawful birth extends the maternity leave by 60 days of 生育假. Each infant beyond the second adds another 15 days, counted as the recorded children born on the event date (`children.multiple_born_on(event.date)`); a multiple birth with fewer than two recorded is refused. The Kunming maternity allowance is outside this row.

name: Childcare leave (育儿假)
authority: Shanghai: 上海市人口与计划生育条例 and 上海市计划生育奖励与补助若干规定 (沪府规〔2022〕18号, from 1 November 2022 to 31 October 2027, https://www.shanghai.gov.cn/nw12344/20221110/87151565cd6246c99854c129797d178c.html) art.3: lawfully married parents each have 5 days of 育儿假 a year until their child turns three, counted by the number of children, at normal pay; each year runs from the child's birth date. 上海市卫生健康委 口径 (Dec 2021, https://www.shqp.gov.cn/wsjkw/wsjkw/upload/202112/1202_170513_376.pdf) Q3–Q4: the year is the child's anniversary year (born 1 December 2021: to 30 November 2022), used within it. Each parent holds the days separately. The lawful-birth test is the operator’s record. Kunming: 云南省人口与计划生育条例 (third amendment 17 January 2022; Yunnan NPC Standing Committee consolidated text https://www.ynrd.gov.cn/html/2022/changweihuigonggao_0118/16355.html): a parent of a lawfully born or adopted child under three has 10 days of 育儿假 a year from their unit, 15 where two or more children are under three; art.35 counts the leave as attendance at normal pay. The year is the calendar year and the days do not carry over; they end when the child turns three (楚雄市卫生健康局 guidance, 18 Sep 2023, https://www.cxs.gov.cn/info/9025/254978.htm). Each parent holds the days separately; whether the other parent’s leave is taken is not a condition. The lawful-birth test is the operator’s record.

Abortion, post-procedure sick leave, no heavy work after insertion, and simultaneous-procedure overlap still require review. https://www.shanghai.gov.cn/rkjsqy2/20230417/e10b476cd14d4af6b079f644c0028d60.html Kunming: 云南省人口与计划生育条例 (third amendment promulgated 17 January 2022), arts.19 and 35: leave is in calendar days and working days inside it are paid. IUD insertion or tubal ligation during maternity leave extends it. Calendar charging, maternity overlap and procedure evidence remain open. https://www.ynrd.gov.cn/html/2022/changweihuigonggao_0118/16355.html

name: Sick leave (病假)
authority: Certified sickness or non-work injury, paid on the day wage (the monthly wage ÷ 21.75). To 15 August 2026, 沪劳保发〔95〕83号 items 3–5 (https://rsj.sh.gov.cn/tgzfl_17732/20230901/t0035_1418018.html): continuous leave within six months pays 60/70/80/90/100% by continuous service under 2/4/6/8 years and above; beyond six months 40/50/60% under 1/3 years and above. Continuous service is this stint’s completed months plus the recorded prior service months, and the six months count from the episode’s first day (recorded defaults). From 16 August 2026 HRSS confirmed the 1995 notice expired and no successor rate was found: the pay is the lawful minimum, 80% of the city minimum wage (劳部发〔1995〕309号 item 59, https://www.mohrss.gov.cn/xxgk2020/fdzdgknr/zcfg/gfxwj/zh/202103/t20210330_412011.html; owner rule 2026-09-28); a contract or collective agreement paying more is the unit’s own row. Every day is floored at 80% of the minimum wage on the day wage. Through 15 August 2026 the monthly day-valued payroll.leave_net_floors rule additionally protects the 沪劳保保发〔2000〕14号 floor after named employee pension, medical, unemployment and housing-fund shares. It settles the calendar illness-month cumulative delta from frozen dated wages, attributed contributions and exact prior top-ups, then freezes each new source/date amount for reversal. Law-silent mixed-day and concurrent-contract allocation is explicitly recorded as owner interpretation 2026-10-02 in payroll settings. Non-monthly/hour-valued leave refuses; eligibility and service-ladder coverage remain separate open scope (CN-SH12.net-floor-80pct). The medical period is not limited here (CN-SH15.protected-medical-period).

name: Annual leave (带薪年休假)
authority: 职工带薪年休假条例 (State Council Order 514, from 1 January 2008, https://xzfg.moj.gov.cn/front/law/detail?LawID=208) art.2: a worker in continuous work for more than twelve months is entitled; art.3: cumulative service 1–10 years 5 days, 10–20 years 10, 20 or more 15 (statutory holidays and rest days inside it not counted); art.5: unused days paid at 300% of the day wage. 企业职工带薪年休假实施办法 (MOHRSS Order 1, from 18 September 2008, https://rsj.sh.gov.cn/trlzyhshbzbgz_17256/20200617/t0035_1388390.html) art.3: the twelve months may be with this or earlier employers; art.4: service with every employer counts toward the ladder (`employment.prior_service_months`); art.5: a new hire’s year is the calendar days left with this employer ÷ 365 × the full days, the part day dropped; art.12: a leaver’s year is (calendar days with this employer this year ÷ 365) × the full days less days taken, the part day dropped, no clawback of excess. Not modelled: the art.4 disqualifications (long paid personal or sick leave) and deemed service. Recorded defaults where the law is silent (owner rule 2026-09-28; 人社厅函〔2009〕149号, http://www.mohrss.gov.cn/ldgxs/LDGXlaodongbiaozhun/LDGXLgongshixiujia/200904/t20090415_86611.html, answers only the twelve months and cumulative service): the calendar year in which twelve months are first completed is granted in full from the day they are, not pro-rated from that day (a 1 October 2025 hire with no earlier service holds 5 days for 2026 from 1 October 2026, and a 31 December 2026 exit is paid 5); a year in which cumulative service reaches 10 or 20 years is granted the higher band in full from that day (a 1 July 2016 hire holds 5 days for 2026 before 1 July 2026 and 10 from it). Neither grants less than a pro-rated reading.

name: Maternity leave (产假及生育假)
authority: Shanghai: 女职工劳动保护特别规定 (State Council Order 619, from 28 April 2012, https://xzfg.moj.gov.cn/mobile/law/detail?LawID=343) art.7: 98 days of maternity leave, up to 15 before the birth; 15 more for a difficult birth and 15 more for each additional infant; a miscarriage under four months of pregnancy 15 days, at four months or more 42 days. 上海市计划生育奖励与补助若干规定 (沪府规〔2022〕18号, from 1 November 2022 to 31 October 2027, https://www.shanghai.gov.cn/nw12344/20221110/87151565cd6246c99854c129797d178c.html) art.2: a lawful birth adds 60 days of 生育假, taken with the maternity leave and paid as it; the added days extend past a statutory holiday. Each infant beyond the second adds another 15 days, counted as the recorded children born on the event date (`children.multiple_born_on(event.date)`); a multiple birth with fewer than two recorded is refused. The maternity allowance offset against the wage (沪医保规〔2026〕5号) is outside this row. Kunming: 女职工劳动保护特别规定 (State Council Order 619, from 28 April 2012, https://xzfg.moj.gov.cn/mobile/law/detail?LawID=343) art.7: 98 days of maternity leave, up to 15 before the birth; 15 more for a difficult birth and 15 more for each additional infant; a miscarriage under four months of pregnancy 15 days, at four months or more 42 days. 云南省人口与计划生育条例 (third amendment 17 January 2022, https://www.ynrd.gov.cn/html/2022/changweihuigonggao_0118/16355.html) art.18, with art.35 (every leave in the regulation is calendar days; working days inside it are paid): a lawful birth extends the maternity leave by 60 days of 生育假. Each infant beyond the second adds another 15 days, counted as the recorded children born on the event date (`children.multiple_born_on(event.date)`); a multiple birth with fewer than two recorded is refused. The Kunming maternity allowance is outside this row.

name: Sick leave (病假)
authority: Certified sickness or non-work injury, paid on the day wage (the monthly wage ÷ 21.75). To 15 August 2026, 沪劳保发〔95〕83号 items 3–5 (https://rsj.sh.gov.cn/tgzfl_17732/20230901/t0035_1418018.html): continuous leave within six months pays 60/70/80/90/100% by continuous service under 2/4/6/8 years and above; beyond six months 40/50/60% under 1/3 years and above. Continuous service is this stint’s completed months plus the recorded prior service months, and the six months count from the episode’s first day (recorded defaults). From 16 August 2026 HRSS confirmed the 1995 notice expired and no successor rate was found: the pay is the lawful minimum, 80% of the city minimum wage (劳部发〔1995〕309号 item 59, https://www.mohrss.gov.cn/xxgk2020/fdzdgknr/zcfg/gfxwj/zh/202103/t20210330_412011.html; owner rule 2026-09-28); a contract or collective agreement paying more is the unit’s own row. Every day is floored at 80% of the minimum wage on the day wage. Through 15 August 2026 the monthly day-valued payroll.leave_net_floors rule additionally protects the 沪劳保保发〔2000〕14号 floor after named employee pension, medical, unemployment and housing-fund shares. It settles the calendar illness-month cumulative delta from frozen dated wages, attributed contributions and exact prior top-ups, then freezes each new source/date amount for reversal. Law-silent mixed-day and concurrent-contract allocation is explicitly recorded as owner interpretation 2026-10-02 in payroll settings. Non-monthly/hour-valued leave refuses; eligibility and service-ladder coverage remain separate open scope (CN-SH12.net-floor-80pct). The medical period is not limited here (CN-SH15.protected-medical-period).

authority: 职工带薪年休假条例 (State Council Order 514, from 1 January 2008, https://xzfg.moj.gov.cn/front/law/detail?LawID=208) art.2: a worker in continuous work for more than twelve months is entitled; art.3: cumulative service 1–10 years 5 days, 10–20 years 10, 20 or more 15 (statutory holidays and rest days inside it not counted); art.5: unused days paid at 300% of the day wage. 企业职工带薪年休假实施办法 (MOHRSS Order 1, from 18 September 2008, https://rsj.sh.gov.cn/trlzyhshbzbgz_17256/20200617/t0035_1388390.html) art.3: the twelve months may be with this or earlier employers; art.4: service with every employer counts toward the ladder (`employment.prior_service_months`); art.5: a new hire’s year is the calendar days left with this employer ÷ 365 × the full days, the part day dropped; art.12: a leaver’s year is (calendar days with this employer this year ÷ 365) × the full days less days taken, the part day dropped, no clawback of excess. Not modelled: the art.4 disqualifications (long paid personal or sick leave) and deemed service. Recorded defaults where the law is silent (owner rule 2026-09-28; 人社厅函〔2009〕149号, http://www.mohrss.gov.cn/ldgxs/LDGXlaodongbiaozhun/LDGXLgongshixiujia/200904/t20090415_86611.html, answers only the twelve months and cumulative service): the calendar year in which twelve months are first completed is granted in full from the day they are, not pro-rated from that day (a 1 October 2025 hire with no earlier service holds 5 days for 2026 from 1 October 2026, and a 31 December 2026 exit is paid 5); a year in which cumulative service reaches 10 or 20 years is granted the higher band in full from that day (a 1 July 2016 hire holds 5 days for 2026 before 1 July 2026 and 10 from it). authority: Shanghai: 上海市人口与计划生育条例 and 上海市计划生育奖励与补助若干规定 (沪府规〔2022〕18号, from 1 November 2022 to 31 October 2027, https://www.shanghai.gov.cn/nw12344/20221110/87151565cd6246c99854c129797d178c.html) art.3: lawfully married parents each have 5 days of 育儿假 a year until their child turns three, counted by the number of children, at normal pay; each year runs from the child's birth date. 上海市卫生健康委 口径 (Dec 2021, https://www.shqp.gov.cn/wsjkw/wsjkw/upload/202112/1202_170513_376.pdf) Q3–Q4: the year is the child's anniversary year (born 1 December 2021: to 30 November 2022), used within it. Through 15 August 2026 the monthly day-valued payroll.leave_net_floors rule additionally protects the 沪劳保保发〔2000〕14号 floor after named employee pension, medical, unemployment and housing-fund shares. It settles the calendar illness-month cumulative delta from frozen dated wages, attributed contributions and exact prior top-ups, then freezes each new source/date amount for reversal. Law-silent mixed-day and concurrent-contract allocation is explicitly recorded as owner interpretation 2026-10-02 in payroll settings. Non-monthly/hour-valued leave refuses; eligibility and service-ladder coverage remain separate open scope (CN-SH12.net-floor-80pct). The medical period is not limited here (CN-SH15.protected-medical-period).

name: Annual leave (带薪年休假)
authority: 职工带薪年休假条例 (State Council Order 514, from 1 January 2008, https://xzfg.moj.gov.cn/front/law/detail?LawID=208) art.2: a worker in continuous work for more than twelve months is entitled; art.3: cumulative service 1–10 years 5 days, 10–20 years 10, 20 or more 15 (statutory holidays and rest days inside it not counted); art.5: unused days paid at 300% of the day wage. 企业职工带薪年休假实施办法 (MOHRSS Order 1, from 18 September 2008, https://rsj.sh.gov.cn/trlzyhshbzbgz_17256/20200617/t0035_1388390.html) art.3: the twelve months may be with this or earlier employers; art.4: service with every employer counts toward the ladder (`employment.prior_service_months`); art.5: a new hire’s year is the calendar days left with this employer ÷ 365 × the full days, the part day dropped; art.12: a leaver’s year is (calendar days with this employer this year ÷ 365) × the full days less days taken, the part day dropped, no clawback of excess. Not modelled: the art.4 disqualifications (long paid personal or sick leave) and deemed service. Recorded defaults where the law is silent (owner rule 2026-09-28; 人社厅函〔2009〕149号, http://www.mohrss.gov.cn/ldgxs/LDGXlaodongbiaozhun/LDGXLgongshixiujia/200904/t20090415_86611.html, answers only the twelve months and cumulative service): the calendar year in which twelve months are first completed is granted in full from the day they are, not pro-rated from that day (a 1 October 2025 hire with no earlier service holds 5 days for 2026 from 1 October 2026, and a 31 December 2026 exit is paid 5); a year in which cumulative service reaches 10 or 20 years is granted the higher band in full from that day (a 1 July 2016 hire holds 5 days for 2026 before 1 July 2026 and 10 from it). Neither grants less than a pro-rated reading.

name: Sick leave (病假)
authority: Certified sickness or non-work injury, paid on the day wage (the monthly wage ÷ 21.75). To 15 August 2026, 沪劳保发〔95〕83号 items 3–5 (https://rsj.sh.gov.cn/tgzfl_17732/20230901/t0035_1418018.html): continuous leave within six months pays 60/70/80/90/100% by continuous service under 2/4/6/8 years and above; beyond six months 40/50/60% under 1/3 years and above. Continuous service is this stint’s completed months plus the recorded prior service months, and the six months count from the episode’s first day (recorded defaults). From 16 August 2026 HRSS confirmed the 1995 notice expired and no successor rate was found: the pay is the lawful minimum, 80% of the city minimum wage (劳部发〔1995〕309号 item 59, https://www.mohrss.gov.cn/xxgk2020/fdzdgknr/zcfg/gfxwj/zh/202103/t20210330_412011.html; owner rule 2026-09-28); a contract or collective agreement paying more is the unit’s own row. Every day is floored at 80% of the minimum wage on the day wage. Through 15 August 2026 the monthly day-valued payroll.leave_net_floors rule additionally protects the 沪劳保保发〔2000〕14号 floor after named employee pension, medical, unemployment and housing-fund shares. It settles the calendar illness-month cumulative delta from frozen dated wages, attributed contributions and exact prior top-ups, then freezes each new source/date amount for reversal. Law-silent mixed-day and concurrent-contract allocation is explicitly recorded as owner interpretation 2026-10-02 in payroll settings. Non-monthly/hour-valued leave refuses; eligibility and service-ladder coverage remain separate open scope (CN-SH12.net-floor-80pct). The medical period is not limited here (CN-SH15.protected-medical-period).
